title: Problems in the flat
instructions: Kiracı Sophie ev sahibini arayıp sorunları anlatıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; sorunları ve çözümleri eşleştir. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Hello, Mr Hill. It's Sophie from flat four. I'm calling about some problems.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: First, the shower. There's no hot water since Monday.

script.speaker: landlord
script.text: Oh dear. I'll call a plumber today. He can probably come tomorrow morning.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: I start work at eight. Can he come after six in the evening?

script.speaker: landlord
script.text: I'll ask. If not, I can let him in with my key.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: That's fine. Also, the kitchen window doesn't close properly, and it's very cold at night.

script.speaker: landlord
script.text: I can fix that myself. I'll come on Saturday at ten.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Thank you. And one more thing. The light on the stairs is broken. It's dangerous in the dark.

script.speaker: landlord
script.text: You're right. I'll bring a new bulb on Saturday too.

questions.prompt: Since when is there no hot water?
questions.evidence: There's no hot water since Monday.

questions.prompt: Why can't Sophie be at home in the morning?
options: She takes her son to school.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the kitchen window?
questions.feedback: Mutfak penceresi tam kapanmıyor; geceleri çok soğuk.
questions.evidence: the kitchen window doesn't close properly

questions.prompt: When will Mr Hill come to the flat?
questions.feedback: Cumartesi saat onda gelip pencereyi tamir edecek ve ampul getirecek.
questions.evidence: I'll come on Saturday at ten.

questions.prompt: Why is the broken light dangerous?
options: It's on the stairs and it's dark.
